name: rezero_save_her
about: Re:Zero story Short: Rem asks Subaru to show her how awesome he can be; he answers with why he keeps dying and coming back - he just wants to see Emilia smile and save her. The drop runs his comeback.

story.why: Rem: show me how awesome you can be, Subaru-kun
I want to see Emilia smile... even if she tells me to stay away, I want to be next to her
it's okay if she doesn't understand. I just want to save her

hook_text: He dies *again and again* for her...
title: He Died Over And Over Just To See Her Smile - Re:Zero
hook: Subaru can't stay dead. Every time he fails, he wakes up and tries again - for a girl who doesn't even know.
